source.authority: Target-exposed consumed cohort; source implementation used only public task text, privileged functional centers, and real camera poses

frozen_algorithm.baseline: All candidates in the admitted local same-action lattice remain set-valued.
frozen_algorithm.successor: Select the requested from-left/from-right rank using a temporally agreed camera-frame x order.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Temporally agreed camera-frame projected x order; smaller x is left.

forbidden_after_outcome: flip camera order using target IDs or evaluator results
change temporal, lattice, view, or gate thresholds
remove tasks or replace the cohort
claim_boundary: Target-exposed consumed mechanism test of temporally stable camera-frame ordering over a privileged functional lattice. It is not fresh evidence and does not establish linguistic canonical left/right, RGB proposal quality, online view reachability, tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
